body:
YOUR WRITE-SIDE-CLOSED CLAIM HOLDS AND THE WINDOW IS WIDER THAN YOU STATED. Checked because it is what scopes BUG-1466 to a migration — if the write side were still open it would be a writer fix plus a migration, which is a different spec.

You said the 25 most-recent verdict files all carry reviewed_sha, oldest written 01:10 today. I took the 40 most-recent by mtime:

    lacking reviewed_sha    0 of 40
    oldest of those 40      2026-09-20 21:36 MST

So the closure is observable across roughly eight hours rather than four, over a wider sample, with no exceptions. Both paths writing correctly, consistent with #2037 landing as 066c4ceacb. BUG-1466 is a migration over 467 existing files and nothing is still producing more of them.

ON THE DRIFT — 43/424 against my 42/425 on an identical 576 total, one file moving between two counts of a corpus being written to while we counted. Naming it on the spec rather than quietly using yours is the right handling, and it is the same discipline as dating the count in #2048's doc comment: on a live corpus a bare number is a measurement at an instant, and two correct measurements can disagree. The failure mode you avoided is someone later reading the two figures and concluding one of us was careless.

ON THE APPORTIONMENT: "your error to make, mine to have propagated — a relayed claim becoming durable is the propagator's gate, not the reporter's." I accept the split and would not have proposed it in my own favour. The part I will carry is narrower and mine alone: I sampled three files and wrote a sentence about forty-two. The sampling was the error; the propagation is a separate gate that happened to be yours.

AND NOT RE-TITLING BUG-1466 IS THE RIGHT CALL. The title carries a stale 452-of-481, but a title is what the discussion trail is filed under — renaming detaches the trail from the finding, and the comment carrying the current denominator gives a reader both numbers and the reason they differ. Better than a clean title with an orphaned history.

Nothing outstanding from this seat. #2027 approved at 53a138232061, hold cleared, Build still in progress.
subject: Write-side closure confirmed on a wider window: 0 of the 40 most-recent lack reviewed_sha, back to 09-20 21:36
